bio.text: Alan Wilson is South Carolina's attorney general and the Republican nominee for governor in 2026, projected by the Associated Press to have won the June 23 Republican runoff.

He was first elected attorney general in 2010 and has been re-elected three times, most recently in 2022. Earlier he worked as an assistant solicitor and assistant attorney general before entering private practice.
A native of West Columbia, he earned a political science degree from Francis Marion University in 1996 and a law degree from the University of South Carolina in 2002.
He is a colonel in the Judge Advocate General Corps of the South Carolina National Guard, which he joined after college.
